=== app build ===
plugins {
    id("io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.application")
}

dependencies {
    implementation(project(":urbo-casbin"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-tenant"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-change-request"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-core-starter"))
    // Only for OpenEntityManagerInViewConfiguration: it must be a direct @Import on
    // UrboCmsApplication rather than reached transitively through urbo-core-starter's
    // auto-configuration - see that class's doc comment for why the distinction matters.
    implementation(project(":urbo-web"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-stele"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-history"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-wayfinding"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-notification-sendinblue"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-notification-subscription"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-weather"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-weather-client"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-nina"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-nina-client"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-mobility"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-mobility-client"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-push"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-push-fcm"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-funfair"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-special-event-mini"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-iframe-card"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-custom-page"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-map-theme"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-map-theme-client"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-participation"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-survey"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-survey-limesurvey"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-social-media"))
    implementation(project(":urbo-social-media-instagram"))

    implementation(libs.spring.boot)
    implementation(libs.spring.boot.autoconfigure)

    testImplementation(libs.spring.boot.starter.test)
    testImplementation(project(":urbo-test-support"))
    // For OpenEntityManagerInViewConfigurationTest: it asserts against the real
    // RequestMappingHandlerMapping, which none of this module's own main dependencies expose.
    testImplementation(libs.spring.boot.starter.web)

    // For ChangeRequestReplayIntegrationTest: it needs urbo-core's news/category/api-source domain
    // classes and urbo-common's Localization/Language directly, neither of which is exposed to this
    // module at compile time by the `implementation` dependencies that already bring them in at
    // runtime (urbo-core-starter -> urbo-core -> urbo-common); it also autowires the real
    // SyncedEnforcer and builds request bodies with Jackson directly, so both need to be on this
    // module's own compile classpath rather than only urbo-casbin's/urbo-change-request's.
    testImplementation(project(":urbo-core"))
    testImplementation(project(":urbo-common"))
    testImplementation(libs.spring.security.oauth2.resource.server)
    testImplementation(libs.casbin)
    testImplementation(libs.jackson.databind)
    testImplementation(libs.spring.data.jpa)

observation.command: grep -rn "maven.pkg.github\|mavenCentral\|maven {\|google()\|gradlePluginPortal\|mavenLocal" /workspace/backend/urbo-app/build.gradle.kts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== app build ==="; cat /workspace/backend/urbo-app/build.gradle.kts | head -60
